svg.text: The panel file (SRP) holds compressed sparse tiles; in memory each allele is one bit, shared by both steps.
Phasing: heterozygotes form segments of up to three (up to 2³ configurations); MCMC samples both paths against panel neighbours.
PBWT: with the panel sorted by reversed prefixes, the haplotypes next to the target's place match it longest: the candidates.
A Li-Stephens HMM runs forward, then backward, over the typed sites: each candidate gets a copying weight.
Untyped sites take the weights interpolated in cM from the typed sites around them; the allele probability is the weight on carriers.
DS = AP1 + AP2 per site, averaged over the phase ensemble, written with the most likely phased genotype.
